jobs.employer: The Law Society of NSW (Clerkship Recruitment Program — all participating NSW employers)
jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027 recruitment round (clerkships over summer 2027/28)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide dates published by the Law Society of NSW: applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027, with two permitted closing dates (Sun 4 July or Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm) chosen by each participating firm, so a single confirmed close date cannot be given; offers may be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027 and must be accepted/declined by 1:00pm Thu 9 September 2027; eligibility is generally penultimate (or final) year of study.

jobs.employer: The Law Society of NSW (Graduate Recruitment Program — all participating NSW employers)
jobs.notes: Law Society of NSW market-offer timetable for the 2027 round: applications open 9:00am AEST Mon 22 Feb 2027 and close 11:59pm Sun 4 April 2027, interviews commence Tue 27 April 2027, offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 2 June 2027 and must be accepted or declined by 1:00pm Thu 3 June 2027; open to final-year students, with individual firms running their own application processes within these dates.

The firm's own careers page confirms its 2026/27 clerkship round has closed and that applications for the 2027/28 Clerkship Program will open in early 2027, but no exact opening or closing date has been published, so both are left null.
